column2: the plan’s acceptance criterion requires `voting-tally-degraded-attempt-*.md` siblings to land in `larch-logs/implement/<run_id>/round-n/`, but validation is weak on two fronts. first, `python/test_run_logs.py` is only proposed as `### may_update:` for allowlist coverage, so a typo in `_round_artifact_allow_globs` or a deny-order regression in `python/run_logs.py` would not be a firm plan commitment. second, the new degraded-retry tests in `python/test_review_and_fix.py` call `_run_round` with `run_id=""` (e.g. lines 3422–3436), so `flush_round_log_after_coder` never runs and tests can only assert tmpdir siblings under `$implement_tmpdir/round-n/`. ci could pass while committed run logs omit the preserved tallies, which is the feature’s main acceptance criterion.
